description: This file contains functions for interacting with Discord API endpoints related to guilds, channels, members, roles, scheduled events, and moderation actions, using the discord-api-types library.

methods.name: fetchMemberInfoDiscord
methods.description: Fetches information about a guild member from Discord API.

methods.name: fetchRoleInfoDiscord
methods.description: Retrieves roles information for a guild.

methods.name: addRoleDiscord
methods.description: Adds a role to a guild member.

methods.name: removeRoleDiscord
methods.description: Removes a role from a guild member.

methods.name: fetchChannelInfoDiscord
methods.description: Fetches information about a specific channel.

methods.name: listGuildChannelsDiscord
methods.description: Lists all channels in a guild.

methods.name: fetchVoiceStatusDiscord
methods.description: Gets voice state information for a user in a guild.

methods.name: listScheduledEventsDiscord
methods.description: Lists scheduled events in a guild.

methods.name: createScheduledEventDiscord
methods.description: Creates a new scheduled event in a guild.

methods.name: timeoutMemberDiscord
methods.description: Timeouts a guild member for a specified duration.

methods.name: kickMemberDiscord
methods.description: Kicks a member from a guild.

methods.name: banMemberDiscord
methods.description: Bans a member from a guild, with optional message deletion.
